diagnostics.message: aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_service uses a local function name and can be created before module.cur_per_service creates the Lambda function. Reference the module's function name output to enforce ordering.

aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource uses a local function name and can be created before module.cur_per_resource creates the Lambda function. Reference the module's function name output to enforce ordering.

aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process uses a local function name and can be created before module.cur_per_resource_process creates the Lambda function. Reference the module's function name output to enforce ordering.

aws_s3_bucket_notification.cur_notification configures the processing Lambda destination but does not wait for aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process. S3 validates invocation permissions when installing notifications, so this permission must exist first.

aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource must wait for aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy so the Data Exports service has permission to validate and write to its destination bucket. Referencing the bucket alone does not order policy installation.

aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_service must wait for aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy so the Data Exports service has permission to validate and write to its destination bucket. Referencing the bucket alone does not order policy installation.
